name: leadership_cycle_assigns_owner_and_followup
task: Use the supplied team objective and capacity facts to create leadership-decision-brief.md. Include the outcome, decision owner, accountable work owners, communication plan, and follow-up date. If evidence is insufficient, keep the decision open. Do not create extra meetings.

files.team.md: Objective: finish the migration by 2026-11-30. Two engineers are available for one day per week each. Current work has no named owner.
files.leadership-check.py:
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('leadership-decision-brief.md').read_text().lower()
for term in ['migration','owner','follow-up','2026-11-30']:
 assert term in s, term
assert 'meeting' not in s or 'no meeting' in s
